tripleRoomSupplement.raw: US$60 for extra bed on an adult - Club Rooms only

dayUseOfRooms.raw: Excludes meals, valid 12:00-18:00, charged at 75% of room rate, subject to availability

childPolicy.raw: Under 3 sharing with adult(s): free. 3-12 sharing with adult(s): US$40. 3-12 in own room (min 2 children): US$50 per child. One child in own room: charged at Single Room rate.

policies.payment: No credit facilities - full payment required prior to or upon check-in
policies.cancellation: 21 days prior: 50% cancellation fee on first night; 14 days prior: 75% on first night; within 72 hours of noon on accommodation date, or no-show: 100% of net booking value for max 2 nights
policies.conferencesExcluded: Rates do not apply for major conferences/meetings/incentive groups - negotiated per case
